items.title: McDonald's (MCD), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
items.summary: McDonald's (MCD) is back in the spotlight as early signs of a U.S. sales recovery intersect with costly restaurant remodels, value bundle tests, and franchisee pushback, which is sharpening investor attention on execution risk. Recent trading reflects that mix of optimism and caution.
